note: Hand-labelled relevance fixture for the public directory search RPC (DEV-1413). Assertions are invariants, not exact result sets: the catalog grows, so 'these must be found' and 'these must never be found' stay true where a frozen expected-set would rot. Slugs were reviewed by hand against name and subcategories, not generated from whatever search returned.

cases.note: Fragrance. The headline false negative: five approved brands carry 香氛 in their own name, and mid-name ones are invisible to whole-run tokenization.
Violin. The catalog has no violin brands, so the only correct answer is nothing. Every slug below shares only the leading 小 and scored exactly 0.2500 against an inclusive trigram threshold.
Skincare, as it is actually tagged (臉部保養 / 身體保養). Exercises the subcategories path at weight C.

The three-character form. Bigrams are ANDed (保養 & 養品), so this matches only brands whose text literally contains 保養品 — brands tagged 保養 alone are correctly excluded, exactly as websearch_to_tsquery would AND two English terms. The first fixture run mislabelled this case with 保養's brands; the search was right and the label was wrong.
Leather. Only three brands carry it in name or subcategories; the rest describe it. Recall here comes almost entirely from descriptions.
Coffee. Mid-name occurrence (里響咖啡) is the whole-run blind spot in miniature.
Ceramics. Already partly working today because 陶瓷 is its own subcategory — a guard that the subcategory path does not regress.
Latin regression guard. Must not move: this query never touches the CJK path.
Second Latin guard, on a term that also exists in Chinese — proves the two paths stay independent.
Two conceptual words typed with no space — the dominant shape of real Chinese input, and the case the first fixture missed entirely. Requiring the junction bigram 灣咖 made this return 0.
A lone ideograph beside a word. The lone 茶 must become a prefix term; handing it to the english parser as an exact whole-run token zeroed the query.
Negation. The excluded term must not become a required one — this returned 16 rows of exclusively coffee brands.
A brand stored as 紙。有光, searched the way it is spoken. Name bigrams bridge separators so the seam 紙有 exists; without that this was unreachable and the CJK trigram cutoff meant nothing caught it.
Two lone ideographs. Must not fall through to the pg_trgm 0.25 floor, which returned 13 brands that merely contain 小 or 木.
Precision canary. If broader CJK recall ever makes this non-empty, the change matched everything rather than the right things.
Two CJK runs separated by a space. Both are bigram-expanded and ANDed, so a brand must satisfy both — not either.
